10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

11017|b4eaeac1.name: Roxxik
11017|b4eaeac1.text: I can't teach what I don't know! If only there was someone else who knew more than I do... wait, there is! Go see Buzzek Bracketswing in Gadgetzan!

11116|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Abeqwa
11116|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

15077|873c8c0b.name: Riggle Bassbait
15077|873c8c0b.text:
Welcome to the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza where each week we choose the finest fisherman to be the Master Angler!

When the tournament is being held, schools of tastyfish will appear up and down the coast of Stranglethorn. While fishing, if your fishing bobber lands in a tastyfish school, then you will catch something from the school rather than the normal Stranglethorn fishing fare.

16014|3a9cb8ee.name: Mux Manascrambler
16014|3a9cb8ee.text: Greetings, friend!  Can I interest you in some ectoplasmic capacitors?  Or perhaps a nice omni-directional spectral assimilator?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

205729|0fc62dd3.name: Boarton Shadetotem
205729|0fc62dd3.text: A fellow disciple of the subtle arts, I see. Perhaps there is something I can teach you.

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2393|e26243eb.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
2393|e26243eb.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

248840|280b51d5.name: Trevan Rol
248840|280b51d5.text: In the darkest of nights, trust in the light to protect you. Of course, having a nice, sturdy mace doesn't hurt either.

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

260873|1d1a8788.name: Dudd Fizzlescroll
260873|1d1a8788.text: Bring me some of that magic gobbledygook and I'll make it worth your time, I swear.

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2798|34baaaf3.name: Pand Stonebinder
2798|34baaaf3.text: Only the renowned Doctor Gregory Victor can improve your skill now.  He can be found in Arathi Highlands at Hammerfall.

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2857|31f4573e.name: Thund
2857|31f4573e.text: You know who's really smart? Nogg! Smarter than me, even. You go tell Nogg Thund sent you! You can find him by the control panel over there.

2858|d37b59d0.name: Gringer
2858|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

3084|a56de79f.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a56de79f.text: First Aid is always a nice skill to have.  Many a time during battle has it saved my hide.  Visit Spiritual Healing on the Spirit Rise.  Pand Stonebinder can teach you all you need to know to save your hide as well.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3318|ae78a458.name: Koma
3318|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3328|0402cd55.name: Ormok
3328|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3328|08830bac.name: Ormok
3328|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3328|88dc2d97.name: Ormok
3328|88dc2d97.text: Messengers from Ravenholdt delivered this letter to me this morning. It is addressed to you, $N.

3341|bdd68929.name: Gann Stonespire
3341|bdd68929.text:
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.

What can I do for you, $N?

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3412|3ec49d32.name: Nogg
3412|3ec49d32.text: You have earned the privilege of training with a higher instructor. Go see my pal Roxxik there.

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3494|a323d91f.name: Tinkerwiz
3494|a323d91f.text: I got nothin' more to teach! Not for somebody who knows as much as you do, anyway! You Horde types need to talk to Nogg in Orgrimmar!

3557|1f4f702f.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|1f4f702f.text: You have learned well my child. Go to the Undercity, find a smith named James Van Brunt. He will be able to teach you much that I cannot. I understand he spends his time near the Warriors training hall, forging their weapons and armor.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4452|a84fd61d.name: Kravel Koalbeard
4452|a84fd61d.text:
Come a little closer.  We have important matters to discuss, you and I.

And some of them we don't want everyone to hear...

4453|f1c43d2c.name: Wizzle Brassbolts
4453|f1c43d2c.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

5594|bbdc551e.name: Alchemist Pestlezugg
5594|bbdc551e.text: In need of some alchemy supplies, are we?  Or do you have other business with me?

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7406|12ee4ac6.name: Oglethorpe Obnoticus
7406|12ee4ac6.text:
Hello there lad... the name's Oglethorpe and I may be responsible for one of the amazing gnomish devices you might possess!  If it blew up, then it wasn't me; if it made you rich though, we can discuss royalties!

Oh, and if you're from Gnomeregan, you can just take two ninety degree angles, smash them together, and start marching.  I have nothing to say to you.

7733|606adfaa.name: Innkeeper Fizzgrimble
7733|606adfaa.text: Ah a visitor! Must be an adventurer, we don't get many tourists down this way. Grab a chair and a drink, make yourself comfortable. Say, you look like you have some meat on your bones. You thinkin about competing in the cage matches?

7824|c5ceacbe.name: Bulkrek Ragefist
7824|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

8126|8b85068d.name: Nixx Sprocketspring
8126|8b85068d.text: Let me break down a little math for you: "goblin" plus "engineering" equals KNOW HOW, baby.  Anyone who tells you otherwise simply doesn't know how to add.

8306|3b48d638.name: Duhng
8306|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

8736|c9966b86.name: Buzzek Bracketswing
8736|c9966b86.text: Show me what you got! You won't be sorry, I promise!

8738|f3c8f530.name: Vazario Linkgrease
8738|f3c8f530.text: Greetings!  If you are here to access goblin engineering schemata, please have your goblin engineer membership card ready for verification.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

1131-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-progress.text: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, $N?
1131-progress.title: Steelsnap

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

4767-progress.name: Elu
4767-progress.text: $N, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!
4767-progress.title: Wind Rider

4821-progress.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.
4821-progress.title: Alien Egg

5147-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5147-progress.text: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?
5147-progress.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

6321-progress.name: Karos Razok
6321-progress.text: You appear to be on official business...
6321-progress.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

8193-progress.name: Riggle Bassbait
8193-progress.text:
Every Sunday, we have a contest to determine the greatest anglers of them all! Just be among the FIRST 50 PEOPLE to bring me some Tastyfish fished from the Tastyfish schools found along the coasts of Stranglethorn and you will be declared a Master Angler!

If you're too slow, my apprentice here will still reward you with money for some Tastyfish you bring her.

Oh, and don't delay, Tastyfish go bad quickly, so don't even think about holding onto them for next week!
8193-progress.title: Master Angler

843-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
843-progress.text: Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!
843-progress.title: Gann's Reclamation

846-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
846-progress.text:
I see you are back, $N.

While Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.

The Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.

If you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
846-progress.title: Revenge of Gann

857-progress.name: Feegly the Exiled
857-progress.text: Where is the Tear of the Moons? I need it now! Need I say!
857-progress.title: The Tear of the Moons

884-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
884-progress.text: $N, there is a new power behind your eyes!  You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
884-progress.title: Owatanka

913-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
913-progress.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

98069-progress.name: Jandia
98069-progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069-progress.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies
